leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a typed useRef hook to store a DOM element reference
Apply TypeScript generics to define custom object types in useRef
Manipulate DOM elements by accessing their properties through typed refs
Configure useRef to persist mutable values across component renders
Integrate typed refs with event handlers to control DOM interactions
Construct a component that uses multiple typed refs for different purposes
Update custom object properties stored in a typed useRef instance
lessonTitle: Type useRef for DOM and custom objects
